name: Tuck Entryfold
acting: Looks down with a flat mouth.
personality: Treats a long document as proof that the border exists.
note: The passport was valid until he unfolded the final page. It had arrived ahead of its owner.

name: Mara Tagwise
personality: Predicts which suitcase will miss its owner.
note: Mara found my luggage before the flight landed. She advised against opening it in this timeline.
voice: Dry, with a slight upward inflection.

name: Otto Ringcoin
personality: Insists that a coin is worth what goes around it.
note: He offered change in three smaller orbits. I am still waiting for one to come back.

name: Edwin Jarhush
acting: Raised eyes and a trembling squiggle mouth.
personality: Declares an item only after it declares itself.
note: He had nothing to declare except the weather inside his jar. The lid disagreed audibly.
call: It was quiet when I packed it.

name: Nell Starwelcome
acting: Upward side-glance and a pointed smile.
personality: Can welcome a visitor through clenched hospitality.
note: The stars indicate a very warm welcome. She removed a fourth after I asked for directions.

name: Pip Tonguetune
acting: Wide look away from the funnel and oblique shout.
personality: Believes his interpreter is making personal remarks.
note: The funnel translated his apology into a further incident. He has asked for a quieter language.
call: That isn't what I said here.
